measurementPolicy.meaning: Evidence-backed end-to-end readiness for a fully working, private, tested, hardened Remote Joining experience.
measurementPolicy.increaseRule: Increase only when new verified evidence materially improves an existing fixed capability domain.
measurementPolicy.decreaseRule: Decrease only when previously credited capability evidence is invalidated or a proven regression removes capability.
measurementPolicy.modelChangeRule: Changing domain weights or the denominator requires a new modelVersion, explicit rationale and backcast of prior comparable scores.
measurementPolicy.reportingRule: Every substantive owner-facing development checkpoint reports the latest calculated score even when it does not change.

domains.label: Deterministic sync and recovery safety
evidence: Two-device/offline-reconnect harness proves stale conflict, replay, reconnect convergence and local-only fallback.
Candidate A/B/C recovery authority and canonical local storage safety remain protected.

domains.label: Identity, authentication, authorization and trust
evidence: Firebase Authentication provider decision and production Google sign-in configuration are proven.
Verified UID to accountId boundary, revocation-aware ID-token verification and operation-specific authorization contracts are proven.
Stage 2I App Check verification order and trusted endpoint attestation contract are proven but production trusted runtime/IAM is not activated.

domains.label: Production cloud and security activation
evidence: Production Firebase project, Web App, Firestore database, restricted Browser API key, Google Auth and GitHub Pages authorized domain are provider verified.
Canonical production Firestore Security Rules are provider verified deployed with application-client writes deny-all.
2026-08-20 provider evidence proves reCAPTCHA Enterprise API/key setup and Firebase App Check Web App registration at one-hour TTL and 0.5 risk threshold with enforcement off.
Production App Check client traffic, enforcement, trusted-runtime IAM and controlled runtime Firebase connection are not yet proven.

domains.label: Devices, pairing, Connected Rivalry and actual Remote Joining
evidence: Remote schema and two-owner governance contracts reserve device, invite, session and rivalry identities.
Actual registered-device lifecycle, private pairing, production Connected Rivalry and a real remote manager join are not yet implemented/proven.

domains.label: Real-device hardening and stable release
evidence: Existing browser-first/offline/recovery discipline and rollback architecture reduce downstream risk.
Remote Joining specific two-real-device failure testing, abuse hardening, production rollback proof and stable release acceptance remain incomplete.

evidenceHistory.reason: Reconstructed the metric against a fixed end-to-end capability denominator after discovering earlier denominator drift between prerequisite completion and true Remote Joining readiness.
Owner provider screenshots prove production reCAPTCHA Enterprise and Firebase App Check registration for the real Web App with one-hour TTL, 0.5 risk threshold and enforcement still off.
